description: Adequate resource capacity to ensure availability is not maintained.
applicability: This signal applies to: All organizations implementing cybersecurity safeguards Data protection and platform security teams Infrastructure resilience programs Organizations managing technology platforms

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Monitor for lack of capacity planning, insufficient resource monitoring, missing scalability mechanisms, inadequate performance baselines, failure to maintain resource reserves, and absence of capacity forecasting processes.

sources.title: NIST SP 800-53 Rev 5 - Security and Privacy Controls
